title: Atomic Chat upstream llama.cpp Release List
description: Schema for the release list of the `llamacpp-upstream` provider: ggml-org/llama.cpp builds this repository mirrors and signs. Every release is pinned by tag, upstream commit and per-asset sha256. A core takes, per backend, the newest release that is not withdrawn, whose `min_core_version` it meets and whose asset for that backend is `approved`; `candidate` assets reach only clients that explicitly opt into unverified builds. Cores before 0.15.0 do not read this file: they follow backends/manifest.json, which moves only to a release every core runs (`min_core_version` 0.0.0).

upstream_repo.description: GitHub repository the releases come from.

download_base.description: Base URL the client prepends to '<tag>/<asset name>': this repository's release stream, whose archives carry Atomic Chat's Windows Authenticode and macOS Developer ID signatures.

releases.description: Newest first. The client chooses among approved, non-withdrawn releases its own version meets.

tag.description: ggml-org/llama.cpp release tag, b<build>. The build number orders releases.

commit.description: Upstream commit the release was built from.

min_core_version.description: Oldest atomic-chat-core this release runs on. 0.0.0 means every core that reads this list; a release that needed a core change names the core that shipped it. Older cores skip the release.

notes.description: Optional one-line summary of why this release is listed.

withdrawn.description: A release pulled from offers. Installed packs are kept.

asset.description: A mirrored backend archive. The client derives the backend id from the name, as it does for backends/manifest.json. The CUDA runtime companions stay on the ggml-org CDN and are not listed.

validation.description: approved: verified for the cores the release names and offered to users. candidate: mirrored, not yet verified.
